non_goals: No optional skill files or activation in this corrective candidate; no DS inputs required.

No installed governance edits, merging, shared/published tags, release publication, self-adoption or fabricated human sign-off. Disposable private fixture tags used by rehearsal are test artifacts only.
No changed workflow/lifecycle/execution semantics outside already frozen core corrective commit.
acceptance_requirements: Release anchor closeout passes with v3.0.0 MAJOR and migration; candidate explicitly unreleased.
Keep final tested SHA/payload identities in external evidence, not a self-referential tracked file.
Core-only installed consumer rehearses exact pinned local candidate with no documentation-skills access, validates and verifies inventory; prior released payload retained for immutable rollback.
Public onboarding never pairs future version tag with prior release SHA; examples require explicit approved immutable source identity.
Independent corrective exit is prepared before any optional source commit, human sign-off/merge/tag remain actual gates.

verification.acceptance_test: Public entry and installed contract coherence

evidence_convention: Exclusive capture records; final commit and payload hash outside frozen source; local rehearsal tags not pushed and removed after consumer inventory verification.
role_allocation: Standard root combines Planner/Generator/Validator/Orchestrator; first_contact independent Evaluator for this release-preparation feature.
